node.statement: Halo-robust height collapse: for an exact signed idempotent P with 0 < delta(P) <= 1/4, nonempty visible set W(P), and hidden top vertex v of height H, let sigma be the invisible mass of v, sigma_g the halo-robust invisible mass (the positive coefficient mass v places on rows at ell-1 distance > tau/4 from conv W, tau = sqrt(delta)), and nu_v the row negative mass; then H * (1 - sigma_g) <= (sigma - sigma_g) * tau/4 + nu_v * (2 + 4*delta).
